item.description:
### Your organisation's filter strength now applies
If your Mac is managed, the filtering level your administrator or parent chooses — Low, Medium or High — is now the level this Mac actually uses. It is applied as soon as the device checks in, and the Home card names the level that is really in force rather than one you picked earlier.
### Setup follows the level you were given
Safe Internet's setup screen no longer starts you on a level of its own. On a managed Mac it opens on the one your organisation set, so turning protection on never quietly changes it.
### A newly enrolled Mac is protected sooner
After enrolling, the Mac now asks for its settings every few seconds until the first answer arrives instead of waiting for the next minute's check-in.
